title: arnica montana var. atlantica
intro: Arnica montana var. atlantica, commonly known as Atlantic mountain arnica, is a plant species in the sunflower family, characterized by its yellow flowers and hairy leaves. It has been used in traditional medicine to alleviate various health issues, including pain, inflammation, and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Atlantic mountain arnica include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which make it effective in treating bruises, sprains, and minor burns. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
